aha: Each stone rests on the sand layer: tunnel only under the two stones that fill the hole, and never under the stone in front of the gate.
deadlocks: Digging down right at the start and tunnelling left: the stone in front of the gate drops and seals it.
Pushing the pearl before both stones are in the hole: it drops in.
Pushing the dropped stone left from its right side: it can end up jammed against the pearl.
